| Vercel | [Trust Center](https://security.vercel.com/subprocessors) (the old vercel.com/legal/sub-processors URL redirects here) | Not retrieved | 8/21/26 |

**Locations outside the US and EU**
- **Linear:** none named. Cloudflare is listed as "Global", and everything else is US or EU.
- **Notion:**
  - **Korea and Japan:** AWS, Confluent, Turbopuffer, StarTree and Fivetran. PlanetScale is listed for Japan.
  - **Singapore:** Mathpix.
  - **UK:** X.AI.
  - **"Global":** Anthropic, Cloudflare, Fireworks, OpenAI, Google, Baseten and Modal.
  - **Notion's own entities:** India, Japan, Australia, UK and South Korea.
- **Figma:**
  - **Singapore:** Kling AI.
  - **Israel and UK:** Lightricks.
  - **Indonesia and Malaysia:** BytePlus and Enhancor.
  - **Canada and the Philippines:** IntouchCX.
  - **Global routing:** the AI providers carry a note that some requests may be routed through global data centers.
  - **Figma's own entities:** Australia, Brazil, Canada, India, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Israel, New Zealand and the UK.
- **Vercel:** I couldn't confirm any locations.
- **Intercom:**
  - **Australia:** an optional hosting region.
  - **Affiliates:** Intercom Software UK Limited in the UK and Intercom Software Australia Pty Ltd in Australia.
- **Retool:** all US. Retool UK Limited is listed separately as an affiliate, and the page gives no location for it.
- **Airtable:**
  - **Australia:** AWS, for data-residency customers only.
  - **Honduras and the Philippines:** PartnerHero.
  - **Global:** AWS for in-product AI, and Google.
  - **Affiliates:** Australia, Canada and the UK.
- **Loom:**
  - **AWS:** many regions, including Canada, Australia, Singapore, South Korea, India, Japan, Switzerland, the UK, Bahrain, Mexico, Brazil, South Africa and Indonesia.
  - **PartnerHero:** the Philippines and South Africa.
  - **Google Vertex AI:** Singapore and Taiwan.

**Caveats for the review**
- **Vercel:** its trust-center page says "Last updated 8/21/26" but the list itself wouldn't render. The recent update notices name SpaceXAI (xAI), Baseten, Cerebras, Fireworks, Groq and Raindrop.ai (AI vendors), and the page lists Honeycomb, Datadog, Microsoft, Google and AWS. That is not the full list, and it gives no locations. Get the full list from the Trust Center directly or from privacy@vercel.com.
- **Linear:** I read only the first 10 of 34 rows on the Trust Center. The full 34 and their locations come from DPA Exhibit B. I assumed the two match, but I didn't confirm that. A third-party review described a separate `linear.app/subprocessors` page as a stub, so use the Trust Center.
- **Figma, Intercom, Retool, Airtable and Loom:** I read these through a fetch tool that summarizes pages, so the counts and locations could contain errors. Notion's list and Vercel's page were read directly. Loom's own summary also gave inconsistent totals, so recount against the page before you cite it.
- **Stale snippets:** web search snippets gave older dates for Figma (Aug 7) and Airtable (Jul 6). The pages themselves show the later dates in the table.

Sources: [Linear Trust Center](https://trust.linear.app/subprocessors), [Linear DPA](https://linear.app/dpa), [Notion](https://notion.notion.site/Notion-s-List-of-Subprocessors-268fa5bcfa0f46b6bc29436b21676734), [Figma](https://www.figma.com/sub-processors/), [Vercel Trust Center](https://security.vercel.com/subprocessors), [Intercom](https://www.intercom.com/legal/subprocessors-list), [Retool](https://docs.retool.com/legal/subprocessors), [Airtable](https://www.airtable.com/company/subprocessors), [Atlassian (Loom)](https://www.atlassian.com/legal/sub-processors)
